name: code-architecture
description: Engineering process: plan-before-code, YAGNI, SOLID principles applied with judgment, task orchestration, work verification — enforced by a blocking Stop hook that refuses a completion claim when files were edited but nothing ran afterward — low-cognitive-load code, KISS/DRY simplicity principles. Owns code-level structure — units, interfaces, file placement; defers system-level topology (service boundaries, scaling, caching) to the system-design plugin.
